question.text: The greenhouse effect is because of the

options.text: presence of gases, which in general are strong infrared absorbers, in the atmosphere
presence of $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$, only in the atmosphere
pressure of $\mathrm{O}_{3}$ and $\mathrm{CH}_{4}$ in the atmosphere

solution.text: Green house gases such as $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$, ozone, methane, the chlorofluorocarbon compounds and water vapour form a thick cover around the earth which prevents the IR rays emitted by the earth to escape. It gradually leads to increase in temperature of atmosphere.
